41924: A mysterious girl who lives on the third floor over Hanamaru ramen shop. Her age is unknown but looks like a 12 or 13 years-old girl. She is short, pale white, and has long black hair. She calls herself Alice (a mixed reading of the kanji for Yūko) and a "NEET Detective".
42917: Main protagonist. He is a common 16 year-old high school student. He lives with his older sister and because of several school transfers he has become introverted.
42918: Narumi's classmate. She is a very active and cheerful girl. She works part-time at a ramen shop called Hanamaru. She was the only member of the gardening club, but made Narumi join her, starting a friendship with him.
42919: She runs the Hanamaru ramen shop where the group hangs out. She attended a confectionery school and intended to open an ice cream parlor but ended up managing her father's ramen shop after he left.
42920: One of the NEET Detective Team members. Ex-boxer and addicted to gambling, he loves dice games and horse races. He is a former drop-out of Narumi' high school and has connections with the local police.
42921: One of the NEET Detective Team members. He is an university student, but his appearance is of a elementary school boy. He rarely attends classes and is enrolled to use the university library.
42922: One of the NEET Detective Team members and the only one with a driving licence. Because of his very handsome and gentle appearance he is quite popular among girls, therefore he has many girlfriends at the same time. Narumi thinks of him as a gigolo.
42923: He is the head and one of the founding members of a young NEET yakuza group called Hirasaka-gumi. He has a ferocious looks and a violent attitude. He often lends a hand to Alice's cases.
44326: Meo is a half-Thai/Japanese girl. Her name is related to the sound of a cat. On her blue t-shirt is the Thai word "น่ารัก" which means "cute". When she moved to Japan with her parents, her father originally fell under the Yakuza but vowed to lead a straight life for his family.
44334: She was a highly respected girl at her school, with good grades, pretty and loved by all. But the perfect image she had caused pressure she couldn't handle and she eventually started working as a prostitute to destroy her good name.
44336: Shouko's boyfriend. Satoshi and Shouko met when he ordered her as a prostitute, thinking she was older, but after accidentally finding out she was a school girl, he decided not to use her and to take her on an actual date. They fell in love and even had sex.
44439: A yakuza who has long abandoned his past as a promising baseball player after falling into trouble with a gambling ring. Not much is known about his past but it is shown that his skills in baseball were incredibly adept.
44441: An admirer of Narumi and a member of the Hinamura group.
44861: He runs a financing company named "Hello Corporation" as a front for the Kishiwada Group.
45889: He was a sworn brother to Soichirou. The leader of the Hirasaka group.
47811: The manager of the sewing equipment shop where Soichirou finds materials to fix Yuuko's toys. Soichiro addresses Yoshiki with respect, while Yoshiki calls him by the nickname "Hina" and constantly teases him.
48497: Nishimura is the manager of the Arcade that the guys usually go to.
48933: Ayaka's older brother who she noted a few times she haven't seen for a long time. When they meet, he refuses to let her near him. He is very hostile towards his sister and thinks of her as a bother.
